findings.observed: acceptance-manifest.json now carries a B-10 entry (lines 202-215). Its given states the recording path does not exist today, naming both absences the explorer evidence established — no logger.phase entry in run.log for a refused assembly, and the summary table rendering a slice's error only for AWAITING-ADJUDICATION. Its when names both new exported functions and their seams: renderPromptPreparationRefusal(sliceTag, message) called at the generator assembly seams through logger.phase (RunJournal.phase appending to run.log) before the error is rethrown unchanged, and promptPreparationRefusalSection(slices) included by Logger.writeSummary for every ERROR slice whose error carries the CONFIGURATION: prefix. Its then requires the whole retained refusal text in run.log and the full recorded message in run-summary.md — every total and per-artifact referenced weight, nothing omitted, truncated, or summarized — with the thrown type, message, and terminal outcome unchanged, which keeps it consistent with P-04. observableResult names src/logger.test.ts and both functions under test; preservation is false and gateIds are typecheck, tests, acceptance:behaviors, identical to B-01 through B-09, so the acceptance:behaviors gate has a B-10 id to select and AC7's run.log / run-summary.md half is now gate-bound. src/logger.ts and src/logger.test.ts were already in fileScope, so no scope gap remains. findings.observed: acceptance-manifest.json now carries a P-05 entry (lines 216-229) with preservation true. Its given is a run directory whose journaled prompt-assembly events carry only the pre-slice field set, enumerating the five absent fields (inline weight, referenced weight, required-input total, allowed total, per-artifact referenced weights). Its when is that run being resumed and its summary written after this slice. Its then states the unchanged resume decision and unchanged run-summary prompt-bytes aggregation with the absent referenced weight read as absent rather than as zero, citing the src/logger.ts:465-466 read rule. Its observableResult names both declared journal-replay seams, src/resume-integration.test.ts and src/orchestrator-runs.test.ts, and explicitly reuses an existing scenario's fixture rather than adding a spawned scenario, which is consistent with the non-goal against a new spawned scenario and with AGENTS.md's assertion ordering. gateIds are typecheck, tests, acceptance:behaviors, so an implementation that made the new prompt-assembly fields required, or that aggregated an absent referenced weight as zero, now fails a gate. The two fileScope paths src/resume-integration.test.ts and src/orchestrator-runs.test.ts consequently have a manifest behavior stating what they must assert, closing the condition F-02 described, and B-06's revised manifest entry states the optional-on-read rule and points at P-05, so that delegation now terminates in a gate-bound entry rather than in prose.
